create_autoconfig_from_pretrained: create AutoConfig instance from pretrained model name or local path using from_pretrained method
create_autoconfig_for_model: create AutoConfig instance for a specific model type like bert or gpt using for_model method
create_autoconfig_register: register a custom PreTrainedConfig class with AutoConfig under a given model type
create_config_mapping_keys: list all available model types and their config classes from CONFIG_MAPPING
create_config_class_to_model_type: convert a config class name back to its corresponding model type string
